description: Get the DevicErts record of one manufacturer by slug: name and registered names, country with its basis, registry identifiers (EUDAMED SRN, FDA FEI, DUNS), device counts per registry and risk class, up to 10 of its devices, its EU certificates and up to 10 recent FDA recalls matched to it. Use when the manufacturer slug is known (from search_manufacturers or get_device) and the company profile is needed. Do not use to find a company by name (use search_manufacturers), to list all its devices (use search_devices with the manufacturer filter), or for all its recalls or certificates (use search_recalls with firm, search_certificates with manufacturer). Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

slug.description: Manufacturer slug: the last part of its https://devicerts.com/manufacturers/<slug> URL, as returned by search_manufacturers or get_device. A full page URL is accepted. e.g. philips-medical-systems-nederland-b-v

name: get_manufacturer
title: Get a manufacturer
